documentation_excerpts.text: ``ibflex`` is a Python library for converting brokerage statement data in Interactive Brokers' Flex XML format into standard Python data structures, so it can be conveniently processed and analyzed with Python scripts.
*N.B. This module has nothing to do with programmatic trading. It's about reading brokerage reports.*
